name: forgeplan-workflow
description: Structured engineering workflow for forgeplan users. v1.20.0: Step 1 reads forgeplan status + session — two one-glance tools no pipeline path ever invoked; a stale session phase now gets said out loud instead of silently contradicting the cycle (marketplace#263). v1.19.0: the last two unwired stages get steps — Step 2.5 dispatches brief-intake when a task arrives as a raw idea, Step 4.4 dispatches goal-planner with forgeplan_decompose at Deep+ (the tool was named everywhere and invoked nowhere on the pipeline path), and Step 8a actually dispatches guardian before activation — the matrix named it activate.primary while the executor ran review+activate inline and promised guardian only in prose (EVID-231). Provides /forge-cycle (full SDLC cycle) and /forge-audit (multi-expert review), methodology knowledge base, quality gate hooks. Requires forgeplan CLI. v1.18.0: the pipeline's last two unexecuted stages now run - Step 4.65 grew a second half that calls /estimate at Deep+ (the depth half already existed; the effort half never did), and a new Step 10 runs /wrap after the commit, because `forgeplan drift` before the commit measures a working tree nobody else can see. Step 0.5 documents the `skill:<name>` sentinel and states what it does on a miss: say the skill is missing and continue - never silently skip the stage, never substitute an agent for it (marketplace#233, #234). v1.13.0: /forge-cycle codifies the autonomous build-workflow discipline (marketplace#169) - Step 4.6 bakes the project's hard constraints verbatim into the Build dispatch prompt (catch spec-vs-constraint violations at design time), a spec-as-built reconciliation gate before Step 8 activation (an omitted-by-redline PRD/RFC mandate must be reconciled in the artifact body first), and a self-verify + claim-sweep discipline when a Step 6.5/6.6 reviewer dispatch crashes outright. v1.12.0: Sprint Z7 PRD-059 — /forge-cycle Step 4.5 FPF ADI mandatory for Standard+ (≥3 hypotheses required; guardian BLOCKER when no ADI EVID). v1.11.0: Sprint Z6 PRD-057 — /forge-cycle Step 6.5 BMAD adversarial review mandatory for Standard+ (guardian BLOCKER when zero Profile B EVID). v1.10: PRD-034 Sprint F — /forge-cycle template clarified (Anomaly #1 fix) + Phase 6.7/Step 7.7 live-smoke discipline check (Anomaly #11 wiring). v1.9.1: forge-advisor agent canonical-lint compliant.
